risk: Any unauthenticated user can trigger AI generation and consume OpenAI API credits

risk: Pipeline cron jobs that read/write these tables will fail silently with permission denied
fix: Add explicit TO service_role ALL policy on both tables

risk: Exposes internal pipeline execution details to any authenticated user

issue: Policy named 'admin-only' but USING(true) on authenticated role gives all users read access
risk: Any authenticated user can read market/ranking snapshots
